Remarks	

Located just a minute's walk from Kichijoji Station, our restaurant specializes in authentic yakitori and handmade seasonal obanzai dishes. Enjoy the friendly service from our owner while you dine!
"Yakitorito Obanzai Sakamoto" is a hidden gem in Kichijoji.
We skewer fresh domestic chicken daily, offering a wide variety of rare cuts.
We serve authentic yakitori grilled over binchotan charcoal to maximize flavor, along with the chef's daily selection of obanzai dishes that highlight seasonal ingredients.
Feel free to stop by whether you're alone, with colleagues, friends, or family!

閉じる

前へ

Food 【Our Specialty】Enjoy Our Fresh Domestic Yakitori!

We offer a wide variety of skewers, including popular favorites like negima (green onion and chicken), thigh, tsukune (chicken meatballs), seseri (neck meat), chicken wings, and liver, all of which are our specialties! We also recommend our limited menu items featuring Hinai jidori (a type of chicken) and hatsumoto, as well as seasonal dishes made with carefully selected ingredients. We have a great selection of sake, sour cocktails, and wine that pair perfectly with our food, so please feel free to stop by!

次へ
前へ

Drink【Drinks】A wide variety of options including beer, wine, sake, and more!

Of course, we have a wide variety of delicious drinks that pair perfectly with yakitori and vegetable skewers, including beer, highballs, tea-based cocktails, sake, and wine! We offer four types of bottled beer: "Sapporo Red Star," "Kirin Classic Lager," "Asahi Super Dry," and "Suntory Premium Malt's." Enjoy them alongside our proud yakitori!

次へ
前へ

Space"Enjoy Your Meal in a Cozy Atmosphere Just a Minute's Walk from Kichijoji"

We have spacious table seating and a cozy counter seating available in the restaurant. Whether you're having a drinking party with friends, gathering with acquaintances, or visiting alone, you are more than welcome! We are ready to serve you delicious yakitori and drinks. Please feel free to drop by anytime.

次へ
